deploy.startCommand: set -eu; : "${DATABASE_URL:?Set DATABASE_URL to the Railway PostgreSQL service URL}"; : "${APP_SECRET:?Set APP_SECRET in Railway variables}"; : "${ADMIN_EMAIL:?Set ADMIN_EMAIL in Railway variables}"; : "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:?Set ADMIN_PASSWORD in Railway variables}"; php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction --allow-no-migration --env=prod; php bin/console app:seed-foundation --admin-email="${ADMIN_EMAIL}" --admin-password="${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" --no-interaction --env=prod; exec php -S 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8080} -t public public/router.php
